blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
In the previous lesson, the entry list rendered filteredEntries. Now that we have pagedEntries, we swap it in:

items: The empty check uses pagedEntries.length instead of filteredEntries.length.
The .map() iterates over pagedEntries instead of filteredEntries.

blocks.content: Everything else in the ternary chain (the loading and error branches) stays the same.
Now, let's create the Previous and Next buttons.
